title.zh: 【Telegram 内置 Gram 钱包更名为 Money，并向全体用户开放】
title.en: 【Telegram 内置 Gram 钱包更名为 Money，并向全体用户开放】

current_state.zh:
据 Walt 频道发文，Telegram 内置的 Gram 钱包已更名为「Money」，并开始向 Telegram 超 10 亿用户全面开放，此前该钱包仅对部分用户可用。Money 可用于存储和发送 Gram，以及购买礼物和收藏类用户名；用户可从 Walt 充值，转账即时到账且无网络费用。

此举将一款内嵌的、免网络费的托管钱包从部分用户扩展到 Telegram 全体用户，扩大了 Gram 存储与转账，以及礼物和收藏类用户名购买的使用范围。

该消息由 Walt 频道发布，来源指出该钱包此前仅对部分用户可用。Foresight News 此前报道，Wallet in Telegram 已更名为 Walt，继续提供交易、投资、收益产品、多链资产及跨链转账等服务。
current_state.en: Telegram's built-in Gram wallet has been rebranded as 'Money' and is now available to all of Telegram's 1B+ users, supporting Gram storage and transfers plus purchases of gifts and collectible usernames, with instant, network-fee-free transfers from Walt.

updates.background_zh: Gram 最初是 Telegram 旗下 Telegram Open Network 的原生代币，该项目在 2020 年被美国 SEC 裁定违法，Telegram 随后支付 1850 万美元罚款并退还 12 亿美元。CoinMarketCap 目前的页面显示，Gram 为此前名为 Toncoin 的代币。Walt 最初是用于购买 Toncoin 和比特币的 Telegram 钱包机器人，其官网称已获 1.5 亿用户使用。Telegram 于 2022 年推出可交易的收藏类用户名。
updates.background_en: Telegram's original "Gram" was the native token of its Telegram Open Network, a project the U.S. SEC ruled illegal in 2020, leading Telegram to pay $18.5 million and return $1.2 billion. A CoinMarketCap listing now shows Gram as the token formerly known as Toncoin. Walt, which began as a Telegram wallet bot for buying Toncoin and Bitcoin, says it is trusted by 150 million users. Telegram introduced collectible usernames as tradable items in 2022.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径主要来自分发与托管：内嵌在 Telegram 消费级应用中的托管钱包，把来自 Walt 的散户充值和礼物、收藏类用户名的应用内消费导向 Gram，使 Gram 及与 Telegram 相关的收藏类用户名市场接触到主流用户群体。由于该钱包为托管模式，这部分敞口取决于运营方的托管安排，而非用户自托管。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through distribution and custody: a custodial wallet embedded in Telegram's consumer app channels retail top-ups from Walt and in-app spending on gifts and collectible usernames into Gram, exposing Gram and Telegram-linked collectible-username markets to a mainstream user base. Because the wallet is custodial, that exposure sits with the operator's custody arrangements rather than with self-custody users.
